why: Node step 636 (owner 2026-11-03, «Да, оба (Рекомендую)»: a clock and a calendar for every native element; 551-1 had taken them away): what this element CAN run on a schedule — the catalog of events (handlers written in advance, build process). The person's schedule is NOT here: it is data, `data/cron.json` (outside git) — written on the person's word, no code, no commit, no rebuild. The core draws events + schedule as this element's calendar «Cron events» (data, storage, vectors and graph: «Backup → Cron events»); the element's server checks the clock once a minute (lib/cron/). Times are the local time of the computer. A missed run (computer off) is not caught up. The clock speaks only to this element's own agent (owner 2026-11-03: «Нашей архитектуре никто не может взаимодействовать с какими-либо агентами кроме самих агентов»). Skill: schedule-cron-automations-calendar-reminders-recurring-and-one-time-tasks. Never published in /.well-known/agent-card.json.

events.name: Wake this element's agent
events.description: Wakes this element's own agent with the schedule's own text (field «message»): work for it at that time, or words for the person — the agent passes them to the core's main agent (npm run tell-core), which tells the person. No other agent is reached (node step 636).

events.name: Message in Telegram
events.description: Sends the schedule's own text (field «message») to this element's own Telegram bot. Any reminder is this event with its text — no new code.
